    """Compact every non-background cell toward the full-width background boundary."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full-width stripe identifies the boundary color and compaction direction.
    boundary_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if boundary_row is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    boundary_color = grid[boundary_row][0]
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    out[boundary_row] = grid[boundary_row][:]
    toward_bottom = boundary_row == h - 1
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r != boundary_row and grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] != boundary_color]
        if toward_bottom:
            rows = range(boundary_row - 1, -1, -1)
        else:
            rows = range(boundary_row + 1, h)
        for r, value in zip(rows, vals):
            out[r][c] = value
    return out
